nodes.description: address public owner; set in constructor from msg.sender and updated by transferOwnership
address[] public players; grows via push in enterDraw and is indexed in pickWinner
uint256 public ticketPrice = 25000000000000000000000; used in enterDraw math and set by setTicketPrice
uint256 public drawId; initialized to 1 and incremented nine times per pickWinner call
uint256 public maxTicketsPerTx = 50; per-transaction entry cap for enterDraw
bool public drawLive; gate toggled by startEntries/stopEntries and required by enterDraw
mapping(uint => address) public pastDraw; stores winners written by pickWinner and read by getWinnerByDraw
mapping(address => uint256) public userEntries; per-player entry counter read and incremented in enterDraw
address public oilAddress; token address set by setOil
iOIL public Oil; external token interface assigned in setOil and invoked in enterDraw
constructor(): sets owner = msg.sender and drawId = 1
setOil(address _address) external onlyOwner: sets oilAddress and the Oil interface instance
enterDraw(uint256 _numOfTickets) public payable: validates balance, drawLive, caps, burns Oil tokens then pushes entries
getRandom() public view: derives an index from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and block.coinbase modulo players.length
getPlayers() public view: returns the players array
drawEntrys() public view: returns players.length
getWinnerByDraw(uint _drawId) public view: returns pastDraw[_drawId]
playerEntries(address _player) public view: loops the players array counting matches for _player
pickWinner(...nine salts) public onlyOwner: derives nine winners from getRandom plus salts and stores them in pastDraw
setTicketPrice(uint256 _newTicketPrice) public onlyOwner: overwrites ticketPrice
setMaxTicket(uint256 _maxTickets) public onlyOwner: overwrites maxTicketsPerTx
startEntries() public onlyOwner: sets drawLive = true
stopEntries() public onlyOwner: sets drawLive = false
transferOwnership(address _address) public onlyOwner: reassigns owner
msg.sender: used for ownership checks, token balance lookup and burn target
block.timestamp: used as entropy source in getRandom
external call Oil.burn(msg.sender, totalTicketCost) executed before players/userEntries state updates
arithmetic ticketPrice * _numOfTickets computed multiple times in enterDraw
weak randomness from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and block.coinbase in getRandom
modulo/index arithmetic over players.length in pickWinner (division by zero / out-of-range when no players)
_address parameter of setOil
_numOfTickets parameter of enterDraw
_drawId parameter of getWinnerByDraw
_player parameter of playerEntries
_firstSalt parameter of pickWinner
_secondSalt parameter of pickWinner
_thirdSalt parameter of pickWinner
_fourthSalt parameter of pickWinner
_fifthSalt parameter of pickWinner
_sixthSalt parameter of pickWinner
_seventhSalt parameter of pickWinner
_eighthSalt parameter of pickWinner
_ninethSalt parameter of pickWinner
_newTicketPrice parameter of setTicketPrice
_maxTickets parameter of setMaxTicket
_address parameter of transferOwnership
totalTicketCost local in enterDraw = ticketPrice * _numOfTickets
ownerTicketsPurchased local in enterDraw read from userEntries[msg.sender]
loop counter i in enterDraw ticket purchasing loop
rand local in getRandom built from keccak256 of timestamp/difficulty/coinbase
index local in getRandom = rand % players.length
addressOfPlayer local copy of _player in playerEntries
totalEntries accumulator in playerEntries
firstWinner index computed in pickWinner from rand + _firstSalt

edges.reason: constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, making caller identity the privileged role
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with the owner state variable
setOil is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
enterDraw uses msg.sender for Oil.balanceOf lookup, userEntries accounting and burn target
pickWinner is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
setTicketPrice is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
setMaxTicket is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
startEntries is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
stopEntries is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender
getRandom derives its index from block.timestamp, a miner-influenceable value
block.timestamp feeds the pseudo-random seed used for winner selection
pickWinner consumes the timestamp-derived random value produced by getRandom
enterDraw performs the external Oil.burn call before finishing its state updates
the Oil iOIL interface state variable is the target of the externally callable burn
players.push state mutation happens after the external burn call, allowing reentrant token callbacks to observe stale state
enterDraw computes ticketPrice * _numOfTickets and uses the product for balance and burn checks
ticketPrice is an operand of the unchecked-by-design ticket cost multiplication
_numOfTickets is user-controlled and is an operand of the ticket cost multiplication
getRandom builds rand from block.timestamp, block.difficulty and block.coinbase
pickWinner computes rand + salt modulo players.length and indexes the array in a loop
players.length is the modulo divisor and array bound used by pickWinner (zero/empty array risks)
pickWinner calls getRandom to obtain the starting index
constructor writes owner
constructor initializes drawId to 1
setOil writes oilAddress
setOil assigns the Oil iOIL interface instance
enterDraw reads ticketPrice for cost and balance requirements
enterDraw requires drawLive == true
enterDraw enforces per-transaction and per-player limits using maxTicketsPerTx
enterDraw reads and increments userEntries[msg.sender]
enterDraw pushes msg.sender into the players array inside the loop
getRandom takes the modulo of rand by players.length
getPlayers returns the players array
drawEntrys returns players.length
getWinnerByDraw reads pastDraw[_drawId]
playerEntries iterates the players array counting matches
pickWinner writes each selected winner into pastDraw
pickWinner increments drawId before each pastDraw write
pickWinner reads players at the computed winner indices
setTicketPrice overwrites ticketPrice
setMaxTicket overwrites maxTicketsPerTx
startEntries sets drawLive to true
stopEntries sets drawLive to false
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable
